topic: 5 Git Commands You'll Use Every Day

slides.headline: 5 Git Commands You'll Use Every Day
slides.subtext: Save this before your next project

slides.headline: git status
slides.body: Shows what files you changed. Run this before anything else. Your single most used command.

slides.headline: git add . && git commit
slides.body: Stage your changes and save a snapshot. Write a clear message — your future self will thank you.

slides.headline: git push origin main
slides.body: Sends your local commits to GitHub. This is how your work reaches the cloud and your team.

slides.headline: git pull
slides.body: Fetches the latest changes from the remote repo. Always pull before you start working for the day.

slides.headline: git log --oneline
slides.body: Shows your commit history in a clean one-line format. Great for reviewing what you've done.

slides.headline: Save this list for your next project
